description: This file is a shell script (t1451-fsck-buffer.sh) designed to test the behavior of the 'git hash-object' command when dealing with buffers and truncated or malformed object data. It contains testing functions, setup routines, and various test cases to verify robustness against buffer overflows and corrupted input.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line with a specified type and content to the base file for testing.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that truncated or malformed objects fail as expected, checking for specific error messages.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Runs a series of validation tests on commit and tag headers to verify proper detection of missing or malformed fields.
